Everything you need to know about eSIMs, using Eskimo, and staying connected while you travel.
What is an eSIM?
eSIM is short for embedded SIM, which is a small chip inside your phone or mobile device that lets you instantly download a data plan and get connected.
In other words, you don’t need to remove or replace your physical SIM card to add a secondary (dual-SIM) data plan to your device.
How to install Eskimo eSIM?
Our direct installation feature lets you install your Eskimo eSIM in just 1–2 minutes with a few simple clicks. To get started, make sure you have an Eskimo data plan and an eSIM-compatible device.
Once you’re ready, go to the ’Data’ or ’Account’ page and tap ’How to Install eSIM’. Under the ’Direct’ tab, select ’Install eSIM’ and follow the step-by-step guide or screenshots.
To install the eSIM using a QR code or with an activation code, please refer to the guides below.

You may purchase or top up your data plan directly from our Eskimo app or website. You can search for the desired plan using our search bar → select the country → complete the payment → the plan is added instantly. No eSIM reinstallation is required and it will seamlessly connect to the your new plan (country/region/global) accordingly when you finish your current plan (0 MB), so there’s no data wastage.
Note: Your data plan is ready to use upon purchase or redemption of voucher codes (if any). There is no expiry date for fixed data plans. Data remains available until it is fully consumed.
How does Dual-SIM work?
Dual-SIM allows you to switch between two data plans anytime. With Eskimo eSIM, you can have a secondary data-only plan to stay connected when you travel, without roaming fees or swapping physical SIM cards.
eSIM offers you all the perks of Dual-SIM without needing to have two physical SIM cards or two devices. This makes eSIM perfect for your holidays or when travelling for business.
What devices support eSIM?

How do I transfer my data to others?
You may transfer your data to anyone with a mobile number. Open Data page → Tap the \"Transfer Icon\" of the selected paid data plan.
Enter an amount you wish to transfer (500 MB min). Successful transfers are immediate and ready for use by the recipient.
Please note that only paid plans are transferable and there is no limit to the number of times you may send/receive data transfers.
How long can I store my data plans?
All Eskimo fixed data plans do not expire.
If your device is not eSIM-compatible, your purchased data plans will remain safely stored in your Eskimo account until you're ready to use them.
Once you have an eSIM-compatible device, simply install your Eskimo eSIM and activate your data plan. Your fixed data never expires, so there's no need to worry about validity periods or extending your plan.
Can I use the same eSIM on multiple devices?
No. Each eSIM can only be used on one device at any time. However, you may connect your Eskimo eSIM data with multiple devices by enabling your personal hotspot or tethering.
